scope: Shared BFloatLinearF32 exact aligned batched F32 activation and original BF16 weight capability required by the MLX source
public_contract: Dense rank2 A[M,K],W[N,K]->F32Y[M,N]; rank3 A[B,M,K],W[B,N,K]->F32Y[B,M,N]. No implicit batch broadcasting or F32-A narrowing.
native_lowering: Metadata-only A[K,1,M,B],W[K,N,1,B]->Y[N,1,M,B], single native mul_mat; CPU mixed SIMD dot uses actual batch weight pitch.

actual_windows.source_shape: Distinct actual test weight banks, F32 cancellation rows, M1/M2/M17; existing rank2 and BF16 paths also checked.

cold_only: Actual Q32 K/V-sized batch64 16MiB descriptors and unsupported CUDA N513/batch selector boundary are preparation checks, not original Q32 tensor execution.
limits: CUDA B<=65535,M<=65535,evenK and B>1 requires N<=512 to retain native F32-A matvec without whole-W expansion.
Metal paired-row and I16 batch-broadcast bounds retained; Metal/Vulkan code changed but not compiled or executed in this Windows batch.
New rank3 BF16-A mathematical inference is accepted; ggml CUDA/Metal/Vulkan explicitly decline that domain. Other providers retain their own cold admission; existing BF16-A rank2 behavior retained.
